decisions.reason: The source changes only the footer background from purple to dark gray; it does not change the shared dark page theme.
The client explicitly limits the color concern and dark-gray replacement to the footer, so the landing-page purple background direction remains unchanged.
Changing the footer background color does not alter the decision to omit navigation from the website header.
The source selects a footer color but does not change the required design-token format, token categories, type scale, spacing, radii, or border specifications.
The footer color decision does not change the landing-page copy plan, sections, ordering, setup sequence, or sequence visualization.
The policy destinations and their footer-menu access point remain unchanged; only the footer's visual background color changes.
The source concerns the shared website footer and does not change the Cognito sign-in page's branding, header logo, or landing-page background treatment.
The informational-page shell currently requires a background and header logo; the footer color decision does not necessarily change those shell elements or decide optional footer inclusion.
The admin workspace footer is part of a separate SaaS UI shell, while the source explicitly concerns the website footer.
A footer background-color change does not alter the reusable responsive rules or breakpoint basis.
The website-footer color decision does not resolve or modify any provisioning-wizard styling value, including its surface color or active-node accent.
Changing a footer color does not alter the selected plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
